hero.title: The Treatment You Need. The Medical Expertise You Are Looking For.
hero.subtitle: Helping international patients explore trusted medical treatment options in India.
hero.description: Every medical condition is different. That is why the first step should always be understanding your individual healthcare needs. IBN Sina helps international patients explore treatment options across a wide range of medical specialties in India.

overview.title: Comprehensive Medical Specialties
overview.description: India is home to experienced specialists and advanced healthcare facilities across multiple medical disciplines. We help coordinate your journey based on your specific medical condition and treatment requirements.

specialties.title: Cardiology & Cardiac Surgery
specialties.description: For patients seeking diagnosis, cardiac interventions, heart surgery, and specialised cardiovascular care.

specialties.title: Oncology
specialties.description: Support for patients exploring cancer diagnosis and treatment, including surgical, medical, and radiation oncology.

specialties.title: Neurology & Neurosurgery
specialties.description: Coordination for neurological conditions, brain disorders, and complex neurosurgical requirements.

specialties.title: Orthopaedics & Joint Replacement
specialties.description: Treatment options for joint problems, fractures, sports injuries, and knee and hip replacement.

specialties.title: Spine Care
specialties.description: Support for patients exploring treatment for spinal disorders, including surgical and minimally invasive approaches.

specialties.title: Nephrology & Kidney Care
specialties.description: Specialist care for kidney-related conditions and treatment requirements.

specialties.title: Gastroenterology
specialties.description: Diagnosis and treatment for conditions affecting the digestive system.

specialties.title: Urology
specialties.description: Specialised treatment for urinary and male reproductive health conditions.

specialties.title: IVF & Fertility
specialties.description: Support for couples and individuals exploring fertility assessment and assisted reproductive treatment.

specialties.title: Paediatrics
specialties.description: Medical care for children through appropriate paediatric specialists.

specialties.title: Organ Transplantation
specialties.description: Coordination with appropriate transplant centres for eligible patients, subject to medical, legal, and regulatory requirements.

specialties.title: Other Specialties
specialties.description: If your medical requirement is not listed here, contact our team. We can review your needs and explore suitable healthcare options.

items.title: Personalized Treatment Guidance
items.description: Every recommendation is based on your individual medical condition and healthcare requirements.

items.title: Access to Experienced Specialists
items.description: We coordinate with qualified doctors and hospitals across a wide range of medical specialties.

items.title: End-to-End Medical Coordination
items.description: From reviewing your reports to planning your treatment journey, our team supports you throughout the process.

items.title: Trusted Healthcare Network
items.description: Helping patients connect with suitable hospitals and healthcare providers across India.

note.title: Every Patient Is Different
note.description: The most appropriate treatment depends on your medical condition, diagnosis, and the recommendation of qualified healthcare professionals. Our role is to help coordinate your healthcare journey and connect you with suitable specialists.
